sources.title: Air quality management area
sources.scope: Designation is relevant to plan-making and development management but does not prove site-specific air quality compliance or permission
sources.origin: Authoritative sources; DEFRA attribution; OGL v3.0

sources.title: Battlefield
sources.scope: Registered battlefield geometry is heritage evidence, not exact significance, setting impact or planning outcome for a parcel
sources.origin: Historic England authoritative data; OGL v3.0

sources.title: Building preservation notice
sources.scope: A notice gives limited-time protection and requires an associated listing application; dataset coverage is not national completeness or current listed status proof
sources.origin: MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement; Historic England attribution; OGL v3.0

sources.title: Certificate of immunity
sources.scope: Presence or absence in a mixed-origin dataset does not establish a current certificate, legal effect or site outcome
sources.origin: Mixed authoritative and MHCLG-created content; Historic England attribution; OGL v3.0

sources.title: Green belt
sources.scope: Annual-return snapshot may not reflect boundary changes since submission and cannot prove policy compliance or permission
sources.origin: Mixed origin with MHCLG-created content; OS attribution; OGL v3.0

sources.title: Heritage at risk
sources.scope: Annual register snapshot is stale at access date and does not prove current condition, ownership or planning outcome
sources.origin: Mixed origin with Historic England attribution; OGL v3.0

sources.title: Nature improvement area
sources.scope: Old new-data date and MHCLG-created origin require current local and Natural England verification before site use
sources.origin: MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement; Natural England attribution; OGL v3.0

sources.title: Local nature reserve
sources.scope: Statutory designation geometry does not prove exact site overlap, ecological effect or development acceptability
sources.origin: Mixed authoritative and MHCLG-created content; OGL v3.0

sources.title: National nature reserve
sources.scope: Natural England designation evidence is not an exact impact assessment, consultation result or permission decision
sources.origin: Mixed origin with Crown copyright attribution; OGL v3.0

sources.title: Special area of conservation
sources.scope: Older source snapshot and mixed origin require current authoritative review; designation alone does not complete habitats assessment
sources.origin: Mixed origin with Natural England attribution; OGL v3.0

sources.title: Protected wreck site
sources.scope: Designation or restricted-area geometry does not prove exact legal reach, marine consent or planning outcome
sources.origin: Authoritative Historic England data; OGL v3.0

sources.title: Scheduled monument
sources.scope: Mixed-origin geometry does not establish monument setting, consent requirement outcome or development acceptability
sources.origin: Historic England attribution with some MHCLG-created content; OGL v3.0
